dedupe_keys.name: ifpri impact projections of food production consumption and net trade to 2050 with and without climate change 2019 global food policy report

description: This dataset holds country-level results from IFPRI's IMPACT model for the 2019 Global Food Policy Report, projecting production, consumption and net trade of major food commodity groups to 2030 and 2050. The International Food Policy Research Institute produced it; IMPACT is an integrated system of linked economic, climate, water and crop models whose core is a partial equilibrium multimarket model of national and international agricultural markets, developed with the CGIAR centres and AgMIP. Results come for two baseline scenarios, one with climate change impacts and one without for comparison, by region and country from 2010 to 2050. The data are one Excel file deposited in the IFPRI Dataverse in 2019 with a DOI and model documentation, free to download under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Caveats: these are scenario projections from one model run for the 2019 report, not forecasts; commodity groups are aggregated; and newer IMPACT runs supersede them. A companion dataset gives projections of hunger. Simulation uses: long-term scenario baselines for food supply and import dependence in resilience studies, testing how climate change shifts net trade and exposes import-dependent countries, and setting demand trajectories for food logistics planning. Related records: the IFPRI Food Security Portal (data-ifpri-food-security-portal) hosts IFPRI's monitoring tools and FoodFlows (data-foodflows-us-county-food-flows) gives observed domestic flows.
